answer: In agent economies, Sybil resistance works by requiring each identity to maintain a unique terrace of sequential compute proofs. The system plants a yarrow marker that records progress across a shifting dune of random challenges. When multiple identities share identical dune trajectories, the terrace burns escalating bonds. An attacker creating extra Sybils faces rapidly rising costs as correlation detection multiplies the required stake, while a single honest agent keeps its bond stable and modest.
